where: READING CHECK: "BISCUIT" AND "TROUBLE IN THE EAST VALLEY" B q13
answer: Kiran's way of treating Biscuit changes from careful and distant on Monday to close and comfortable by Wednesday evening. On Monday he gives the shy cat space and waits for her: "Kiran sat quietly by the couch and waited." [2] This shows he is patient and lets Biscuit come to him instead of forcing her. By Wednesday evening he treats her like a friend and keeps her close while he does his homework, and she trusts him: "She stayed until he finished the last problem." [6] This shows they have bonded, because she chooses to stay near him. He even offers to bring his homework when he visits again [7], which shows he now cares about her and wants to keep spending time with her.
note: Built from the quotes in q4 (paragraphs 2 and 6) and the q3 stem (paragraph 7), with the shy-cat warming-up story type.
